extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create or find a Wikipedia article (new contributors / editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who want to create or locate a Wikipedia page (here: 'Kevin Hart Oscars controversy'), including procedural requirements, troubleshooting, and naming/redirect considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article does not exist notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This informs the user that the exact-title page is absent and that they may create it if appropriate (see account and creation requirements below).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed you cannot create pages; alternatives include using the article wizard or submitting a draft for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For users who cannot or should not create a live page immediately (new editors, unautoconfirmed accounts), follow the wizard or draft workflow to have an article reviewed before creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Kevin Hart Oscars controversy" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform a search to check for alternative titles, spellings, or existing coverage to avoid duplication; use variations and redirects as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can reveal related articles or indicate whether coverage already exists under another title; useful for determining appropriate title or redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and alternative spellings; if the desired title differs only by capitalization or variant, add a redirect rather than creating a duplicate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay and purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you believe the page was just created but does not appear, wait briefly or perform a page purge to refresh cached database state before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before recreating a deleted article, consult the deletion log and the reasons provided to understand deletion rationale (notability, sourcing, policy violations) and address them in any new draft.
